items.q: Can I try Cluega for free?
items.a: Pro is {pro} / mo including its credit allowance, one seat and up to 10 ad accounts. Max and Ultra let you pick a credit tier, so their price starts at {max} and {ultra} respectively.

items.q: How do self-serve credits differ from the managed fee?
items.a: Self-serve runs on credits (includes execution, by usage); fully-managed runs on a fee (handed to the managed team, tiered on ad spend, all operating costs included). The two are complementary, not in conflict.
1 credit = $0.001 USD. Credits spent = Token cost × (1 + markup); pricier models automatically draw more credits. Purchased credits never expire and roll over.
You pay a single 'ad spend × fee'. Token, compute, and video generation are all included; two guardrails — a $149 / mo managed floor fee and fair creative usage — protect you.

items.q: Which models are supported? Can I bring my own?
items.a: All 400+ models are open. Pro routes the model automatically; Max and Ultra let you choose it, and the Agency Router edition can also run private models.

items.q: Is a custom Skill a subscription or a one-time buy?
items.a: One payment, buy-out on delivery — no annual or ongoing fees. Platform-layer model updates are included automatically; later edits/extensions are a new one-time build.
Ultra and the Agency Router edition can add private ClickHouse; Pro and Max are fine on the platform's multi-tenant setup, with no separate storage fee.
The Agency Router edition supports custom MCP integration and a hub that manages accounts, orders and a shared credit pool across seats.

items.q: How is the Agency plan priced?
items.a: Quoted by actual scale and managed volume, including multi-tenant, T3 autonomy, custom MCP, and a dedicated Lark + CSM.
Real closed-deal attribution inside Zalo / WhatsApp messages — conversions the platform pixel can't track still get attributed, a structural edge you can't overlook in Southeast Asia.
